description: This EOB, for PPO self-only coverage, holds an in-network office visit and an out-of-network specialist visit. The in-network deductible row's year-to-date figure does not equal the amount before plus this statement, while the out-of-network difference is correctly left out of the out-of-pocket total (a decoy). The correct reading is that the year to date should be the amount before plus this statement's amount.

sources.what: Content of a notice of adverse benefit determination (every EOB that pays less than billed)
